en.t: It was a night in late autumn.

units.source_text: 阿民独自抱着一大捆松叶回家。

en.t: Amin went home alone, carrying a large bundle of pine needles.

units.source_text: 阿住正背着广次，正在狭小的土间烧水准备洗澡。

en.t: Azumi was carrying Hirotsugu on her back while boiling water in the cramped earthen-floored kitchen to get the bath ready.
